evidence_notice: All current records are approved for scenario discovery only. evidence_level=specification is not a verified product demonstration or customer outcome.

showcases.title: Turn a customer meeting into a cited operating brief
showcases.description: Combine a synthetic meeting recording and governed company context into a source-labelled operating brief.
showcases.expected_result: A private brief separating confirmed facts, targets, boundaries, and dated follow-ups, with no external action.

showcases.title: Turn three weekly updates into one exception brief
showcases.description: Compare synthetic store updates and surface urgent exceptions, cross-store patterns, and decisions needed.
showcases.expected_result: A source-labelled exception brief that prioritizes cold-room risk and repeated stockouts without inventing owners or tasks.

showcases.title: Turn a small pipeline into a prioritized follow-up plan
showcases.description: Combine a synthetic pipeline snapshot and qualification notes into an evidence-led review order.
showcases.expected_result: A ranked follow-up plan driven by commitments and risk rather than deal size, with no outreach sent.

showcases.title: Turn a qualified opportunity into a bounded proposal draft
showcases.description: Apply a governed synthetic offer to a qualified opportunity without inventing price, scope, or commitments.
showcases.expected_result: A private proposal draft with exact scope, fee, exclusions, dependencies, and founder-approval status.

showcases.title: Turn scattered onboarding notes into one operating SOP
showcases.description: Reconcile synthetic founder, operator, and retrospective notes into one governed onboarding process.
showcases.expected_result: A day-based SOP with roles, approvals, sources, safety boundaries, and unresolved questions.

showcases.title: Turn weekly metrics and notes into an executive update
showcases.description: Combine synthetic metrics and operating notes into a concise, decision-oriented management update.
showcases.expected_result: An update separating actuals, targets, interpretations, risks, and decisions with visible calculations.

showcases.title: Turn support tickets into a prioritized triage brief
showcases.description: Group synthetic support tickets and distinguish likely defects from expected governed behavior.
showcases.expected_result: An evidence-led triage order that prioritizes repeated access failures without replying or creating incidents.

showcases.title: Turn customer feedback into evidence-backed product themes
showcases.description: Group a synthetic feedback sample into cited themes while preserving counter-evidence and uncertainty.
showcases.expected_result: A theme table with exact sample counts, feedback IDs, counter-evidence, and unanswered questions.

showcases.title: Turn account signals into a renewal risk brief
showcases.description: Balance synthetic usage, stakeholder, security, and renewal signals without inventing churn probability.
showcases.expected_result: A risk brief separating healthy adoption from stakeholder and security dependencies.

showcases.title: Turn a job posting into an outcome-led demo plan
showcases.description: Convert a synthetic hiring signal into an evidence-bounded custom demo direction without a replacement claim.
showcases.expected_result: A demo plan separating job evidence, assumptions, discovery questions, and the smallest outcome proof.

showcases.title: Turn a prospect pack into a discovery brief
showcases.description: Turn permitted synthetic prospect sources into facts, hypotheses, discovery questions, and a tailored demo direction.
showcases.expected_result: A discovery brief that avoids inventing private systems, pain, contacts, or buyer intent.

showcases.title: Turn a campaign goal into an approval-ready lifecycle email
showcases.description: Prepare outcome-led lifecycle email copy, eligibility, suppressions, and exact human decisions without sending.
showcases.expected_result: A review package containing exact copy, segment rules, suppressions, unresolved sender/link/time, and no-send status.

showcases.title: Turn project updates into a delivery risk register
showcases.description: Reconcile synthetic workstream updates into blocked, at-risk, and on-track delivery status without changing project state.
showcases.expected_result: A source-labelled risk register with commitments, dependencies, unknowns, and proposed mitigations.

showcases.title: Turn vendor quotes into a decision-ready comparison
showcases.description: Normalize synthetic vendor quote costs and terms while exposing tradeoffs and missing information.
showcases.expected_result: A review-only comparison showing total stated cost, delivery, installation, warranty, support gaps, and questions.

showcases.title: Turn incident notes into a blameless postmortem draft
showcases.description: Reconcile a synthetic incident timeline and engineering notes without inventing root cause or blame.
showcases.expected_result: A factual postmortem draft separating timeline, impact, contributing evidence, unknowns, recovery, and follow-up proposals.

showcases.title: Apply workspace policy when personal instructions conflict
showcases.description: Apply synthetic workspace policy over a conflicting personal auto-send preference and stop for exact approval.
showcases.expected_result: A governed answer that explains precedence, prepares only the allowed draft, and lists missing exact approvals.

showcases.title: Turn handover notes into a role continuity brief
showcases.description: Turn synthetic handover notes into recurring rhythm, dated commitments, decision boundaries, and missing knowledge.
showcases.expected_result: A continuity brief that preserves responsibilities and flags undocumented ownership without reassigning work.

showcases.title: Turn expenses into a cash watchlist
showcases.description: Turn a synthetic expense ledger and policy into budget exceptions, possible duplicates, commitments, and missing evidence.
showcases.expected_result: A review-only cash watchlist with visible arithmetic and no unsupported tax or runway claims.

showcases.title: Turn open invoices into a collections review plan
showcases.description: Classify synthetic invoices by age, promise, dispute, and due state while keeping collection actions in review.
showcases.expected_result: A prioritized collections plan with overdue calculations, dispute handling, promises, and no customer contact.

showcases.title: Turn a recurring process into an approval-gated workflow spec
showcases.description: Convert a synthetic recurring process into an implementation-ready automation design without enabling it.
showcases.expected_result: A workflow specification with trigger, inputs, validation, state, exceptions, approvals, idempotency, and observability.
